System balance = starting balance + deposits − withdrawals − fees (each account's fee rate) ± transfers and other movements. Enter the real balance from the bank or PG and the difference shows at once. Differences up to {tol} count as matched.
系统余额 = 期初余额 + 充值 − 提款 − 手续费（按各账户费率）± 转账和其他资金进出。填上银行或 PG 的实际余额，马上就能看到差额。差额在 {tol} 以内算对上。

Saldo sistem = saldo awal + deposit − penarikan − biaya (tarif tiap akun) ± transfer dan pergerakan lain. Input saldo sebenarnya dari bank atau PG dan selisihnya langsung terlihat. Selisih sampai {tol} dianggap cocok.
